items.title: Remove the legacy packages/game package
items.context: packages/game is a standalone Vite demo with its own fixtures/screenshots and no dependency from the root Lattice CLI build/test path. Delete the package tree rather than leaving a misleading core package under packages/.
items.userSees: packages/game is removed from the repository, so the packages directory no longer presents the old browser demo as a maintained Lattice package.

happy.desc: git diff shows packages/game tracked files deleted.

edge.desc: No package manager root configuration references @lattice/game or packages/game after deletion.

adversarial.desc: The deletion does not touch unrelated packages or active story worktrees.

verificationEvidence.note: packages/game directory is absent after deletion; tracked files under packages/game show as deleted in git status.
Post-removal repository scan outside excluded story/fixture/Lattice metadata paths produced no packages/game or @lattice/game hits, including root package configuration.
Material diff is limited to deleting packages/game files and updating docs/requirements/decisions/test-fixture-spec.md.

items.title: Replace packages/game fixture examples with neutral example paths
items.context: test-fixture-spec.md currently references browser_test({ projectRoot: "packages/game" }); replace those examples with a neutral external/sample project path so docs no longer imply packages/game exists or is maintained.
items.userSees: test-fixture-spec.md no longer tells readers to use packages/game and instead uses a neutral browser fixture example path.

happy.desc: test-fixture-spec.md browser_test examples no longer contain projectRoot: packages/game.

edge.desc: The replacement examples still demonstrate browser_test projectRoot and fixture usage clearly.

adversarial.desc: No docs outside this intended spec change are edited for this removal.

verificationEvidence.note: The fixture spec no longer contains packages/game in browser_test examples.
The docs still show browser_test projectRoot usage with /path/to/browser-app and a fixture-specific example.
No docs outside the intended fixture spec are edited for the packages/game reference replacement.

items.title: Verify no tracked references to packages/game remain
items.context: Run repository scans for packages/game and @lattice/game after removal, and run a suitable validation command to ensure the CLI product path is unaffected.
items.userSees: Verification reports no tracked packages/game or @lattice/game references remain outside historical story metadata, and the Lattice CLI validation path still passes.

happy.desc: Repository scan for packages/game and @lattice/game has no current product/docs hits after deletion.

edge.desc: Root validation passes after package removal.

adversarial.desc: Any remaining hits are either absent or explicitly classified as historical Lattice story metadata, not current product references.

verificationEvidence.note: Separate post-removal scans for packages/game and @lattice/game have no current product/docs hits outside excluded metadata/fixture/story paths.
npm test passed via packages/main/dist/tasks/cli-e2e.js after the package deletion and doc update.
No remaining current product/docs hits exist; any Lattice story metadata references are process records for this removal, not maintained package references.
